segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Speaker, tungkol sa pagpapatupad ng Executive Order No. 101, ito po yung pinirmahan ng Pangulo ng October 2025 na nagdidirekta sa lahat ng pambansa at lokal natin na government bodies na buong-buo na ipatupad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: In the implementation of the school-based feeding program, since the procurement is already under the division level, so the procurement is already localized and the produce of the local farmers are being considered in the procurement of the rice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: And in fact, the data of the DepEd shows that around 35.2 million na ang nagagamit natin in the procurement from the local farmers in line with the implementation of the program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: So this is in line with the Sagip Saka Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa harap din po ng Department of Agriculture, kami po ay mangihingi ng report tungkol dito.

segments.text: Nasasayang yung pinaghirapan po ng mga local produce ng ating mga magsasaka, ng ating mga manginisda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: I-raise din natin ito sa DA na magkaroon po ng tiyak na pondo para sa panahon na may ganun pong mga kaso, maliligtas natin yung mga gulay, prutas, mga isda, at magagamit direkta sa mga programa ng ating pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago

segments.text: na document, bagamat hindi po ako sigurado kung lahat na po ito ng inyong GAD utilization.

segments.text: Pero ang napansin ko lang po dito ay separate pa rin po natin na ituturing yung mga gender and development related programs, projects, and activities.

segments.text: Yung awareness tungkol sa paglaban sa kahit anong forma ng gender-based sexual harassment.

segments.text: Nandito rin po yung kung paano natin na-integrate yung gender and development sa Human Rights Month.

segments.text: So may mga ganun po na maari po tayong...

segments.text: may mga pamamaraan para talagang integrate din yung economic empowerment ng women

segments.text: at ng mga marginalized communities natin and all gender diverse people sa mga programa.

segments.text: Yung kompletong ulat kung paano yung mga major programs integrated ang gender and development

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ano po ba yung mga dagdag na resources na kailangan ng DepEd upang mapalakas ang mga programa sa pangkabuan na paghuhubog ng mga mag-aaral?

segments.text: At matiyak po na yung pagkakataong ito ay makarating sa bawat estudyanteng

segments.text: Maari ba ang magpaliwanag dito ang ating author?

segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, some of the strategies to be implemented by the department as to the improvement of critical thinking skills among learners

segments.text: This also includes life and career skills and becoming it as the core of the skills.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: To improve also to increase work immersion.

segments.text: And to strengthen the electives for career-aligned critical thinking skills.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: So, yun ay ilan lamang sa mga strategies na gagawin ng Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, pwede niyo po bang bigyan niyong representasyon na ito yung particulars ng 37% na budget cut na gusto po natin makita?

segments.text: sa mga legal basis naman po ng ating learner support program,

segments.text: ang malaking bahagi po sa aming pag-aaral ay tungkol sa pagpapatupad ng ating National Mental Health Policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So, kung baga, kung hindi po natin ito pupondohan ng maayos,

segments.text: paano natin maaasahan na yung agaran na abot kamay, na counseling,

segments.text: iba't ibang support services sa ating mga learners, pati na rin sa mga teachers at lahat ng ating education stakeholders

segments.text: madaling maabot sa kanilang mga paaralan.

segments.text: Bukod pa dito, ginong speaker, nakita rin po natin na ay hindi po malinaw at hindi pantay-pantay, halimbawa,

segments.text: yung pagpupondo dun sa mga spaces sana for socialization ng mga bata ng buong community sa isang eskwelahan.

segments.text: Halimbawa po, yung napakahalaga na pagkakaroon ng mga libraries na may sapat na espasyo at ventilation para sa mga learners,

segments.text: at yung ganitong tipo po ng mga espasyo para rin sa mga student organizations ng ating mga paaralan.

segments.text: Yung tambayan po parang, kung baga, a luxury. Hindi po lahat ay meron maayos na tambayan.

segments.text: So, kung baga, kulang na kulang po yung facilities natin para sa holistic development ng ating mga learners,

segments.text: Kaya po, sinusuportahan po natin ang mas mataas na pondo para sa Department of Education,

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor,

segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Dada Kiram Ismula of party-list Akbayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuhu. Magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Didiretso na po ako. Una ko pong i-focus yung patungkol sa Asatids compensation.

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, parte ng Madrasa Education Program ang Arabic Language and Islamic Values Education, kung saan ang ating mga Asatids ang nagtuturo sa Muslim learners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can you confirm na ang current monthly baseline compensation ng mga Asatids under contract of service ay P12,500?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, the compensation of Asatids,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: is at P12,500 per month, and it was implemented in 2024.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po. Meron po bang plano ang DepEd na i-increase ang monthly baseline compensation na ito para mas maging fair at sustainable ang support sa ating mga Asatids?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, the proposal for increase of...

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, the proposal for increase of honorarium is part of the wish list of the department na sana from P12,500 per month magiging P16,000 per month.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: But again, that is still part of the wish list and that depends sa kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So mula sa P12,500 magiging P16,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: But this is still subject to the availability of funds kung ma-approve yung wish list ng DepEd.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Last year na-raise ko na merong issue sa delay ng pag-disburst ng compensation ng ating mga Asatids.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nais ko lamang i-commend ang DepEd dahil nagkaroon po ng significant improvement sa timeline ng release ng compensation for our Asatids.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sana po ay tuloy-tuloy na masiguro ng DepEd ang timely na release na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Distinguished sponsor, another point lang sa madrasa, education program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Before I proceed to another topic, I would like to manifest na mas mababa po ang proposed madrasa education program budget for 2027 kung ikumpara po natin ito sa 2026 GAA level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dahil dito, naninindigan po kami na ang pondo para sa madrasa education program ay dapat ma-restore man lang sa 2026 GAA level

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: upang matiyak ang sapat na compensation at support.

segments.text: Para sa ating mga Asatids at Muslim learners, nadako po ako sa ISAL teachers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam sponsor, I would just like to clarify kung ang pag-aabsorb po ba sa kanila ay sa pamamagitan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sa pamamagitan po ba ng re-appointment o kailangan po ba silang sumailalim sa re-application?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: With the existing around 800 ISALs, they will be absorbed by the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, walang re-application na mangyari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: However, they will be subject to training, further training, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Gusto ko lamang po din i-clarify.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, they will be absorbed effective January 1, 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po ba kaya magkakaroon ng pagkaantala dahil madi-delay po or by January pa sila magsisimula dahil may ilang buwan pa tayo bago matapos yung 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, the compensation, their compensation will be still under BARM from today until December of this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: And then effective January of 2027, DepEd will absorb for their compensation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam Sponsor, gusto ko lamang po kasing makakuha ng assurance mula sa DepEd.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Na ano po kaya ang assurance na kasalukuyang mga ISAL teachers natin ay maaabsorb po ba talaga?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can the DepEd commit to this po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Sir Speaker, Your Honor, the DepEd is committed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I just want to put that on record dahil nanonood po sila ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Anyway, maari po ba nating malaman kung kailan ang effective date nila?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nasabi niyo po kanina January, effective what January time po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nakakabahala po kasi na hanggang ngayon ay wala pa tayong nailabas na omnibus hiring guidelines or reappointment guidelines or absorption guidelines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nilalagay nito ang ating mga ISAL teachers sa isang limbo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi nila alam kung sila ba ay mahahire or mariri-appoint?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kung kinakailangan nilang maghanap ng iba pang trabaho, at least alam nila in advance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, sana po ay madaliin ng DepEd ang pagpapalabas ng omnibus hiring guidelines or absorption guidelines ba yan?

segments.text: Sa lalong madaling panahon upang mabigyan ng kapanataga ng ating mga ISAL teachers.

segments.text: May katanungan lang po patungkol naman sa paggamit ng AI tools

segments.text: para matulungan ang ating mga guro at personnel.

segments.text: Can the distinguished sponsor discuss how DepEd is using AI in detecting speech impediments and assessing health needs ng mga learners?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, there are already practices being implemented by DepEd in line with the usage of AI so as to assist our learners.

segments.text: So, in fact, there is one...

segments.text: ... one strategy that is being implemented, the taking of picture in taking the height and weight of the learner.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.text: Maari ko po bang malaman kung how much ang budget for...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Is that enough to continue funding for the innovative projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, with regards to AI intervention, this is also part of the wishes of the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora

segments.text: It will now be subject to the approval of the government.

segments.text: Yung this 2026 po, nasa magkano yung budget?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ako po ay dadako ngayon sa mga katanungang gustong ipaabot ng aking kasamahan sa Akbayan na si Representative Chel Diokno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: May ulat tayong natanggap mula sa isang teacher organization na wala pa rin sapat na consultation

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang kagawaran sa mga stakeholders nito patungkol sa mga kamakailang policy shifts

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At karagdagang pasanin sa ating mga kaguruan, paano po makakasiguro ng DepEd na ang mga bagong reforma at pagbabago sa sistema

segments.text: ay may sapat na konsultasyon sa mga guro at may katapat na pondo bago ito ipatupad sa buong bansa?

segments.text: The department actually believes only and recognizes the value of consultation.

segments.text: So, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, yes, the department is committed to reach out all stakeholders in terms of consultation

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Joseph Tan of the Fourth District of Isabela, vice chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Francisco Paolo P. Ortega V
segments.text: The Honorable Joseph Tan is now recognized. You may proceed, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, magandang araw sa ating lahat. Kapag po pinag-usapan natin ang irigasyon, hindi lamang po kanal, dam at istruktura ang ating pinag-uusapan. Ang pinag-uusapan po natin ay tubig na nagbibigay-buhay sa ating mga sakahan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: ani na nagbibigay kabuhayan sa ating mga magsasaka at pagkain na inilalagay natin sa hapag ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino. Bilang kinatawan ng isang agricultural district, personal ko pong nakikita at naririnig ang mga hamon ng ating mga magsasaka. Kapag walang sapat na tubig, walang sapat na ani. Kapag mababa ang ani, mababa ang kita ng magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: At kapag humina ang produksyon ng ating mga bukid, tayong lahat ang apektado sa presyo ng bigas, gulay at iba pang mga pagkain. Kaya ang budget ng National Irrigation Administration ay hindi lamang budget para sa isang government corporation. It is an investment in our farmers, our country, and ultimately in our nation?s food security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the challenge before us is clear. We need to expand irrigation to agricultural areas that still depend heavily on rainfall. We need to rehabilitate aging and damaged irrigation facilities. We need to modernize our system so that water reaches farms more efficiently and increasingly. We need irrigation infrastructure that can withstand drought, floods, typhoons and the growing effects of climate change.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: But funding alone is not enough. Every peso that Congress provides for irrigation must translate into actual hectares irrigated, reliable water supply, higher agricultural productivity and better income for our farmers. We expect NIA to ensure that projects are properly planned,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: implementation-ready and completed on time. We also expect NIA to strengthen its partnership with our irrigators? associations. Hindi lamang beneficiaries ang ating mga irrigators at magsasaka. Partner sila ng pamahalaan. They know their farms. They understand their irrigation system, and they know where government intervention is most urgently needed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: post-harvest facilities, farm-to-market roads, credit and market access,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: we will achieve more if our farmers have one of the most basic requirements of agriculture, water.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: And this is precisely why investment in irrigation matters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: At the same time, this representation recognizes that Congress has the responsibility

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: not only to provide resources, but also to demand accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: We expect NIA to implement project efficiently, address delay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: strengthen coordination with local government and farmers' organizations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: and ensure that public funds produce measurable results on the ground.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Ang tunay po na sukatan ng budget nito ay hindi kung magkano ang ating inilaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Ang tunay na sukatan ay kung ilang magsasaka ang natulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Ilang ektarya ng sakahan ang nagkaroon ng maaasahang patubig,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: at gaano kalaki na itulong nito sa kita ng ating mga magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, food security begins long before food reaches our market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: And very often, it begins with water.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Kaya sa bawat irrigation canal na ating ginagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: sa bawat irrigation system na ating nirarehabilitate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: at sa bawat bagong sakahan na naaabot ng tubig,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: nagbibigay tayo ng pagkakataon sa ating mga magsasaka

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: na magkaroon ng mas magandang ani at mas maayos na buhay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: we strengthen our country's capacity to produce its own food.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: I respectfully submit for the consideration of this August Chamber,

segments.text: At maganda rin naman kung yun ang pagkakataon po na sambitin sa kapulong ito na ang NIA rin po ngayon ay meron din po NIA transparency portal.

segments.text: At yun ho ay hindi, ang ibig sabihin, kasalukuyang pong binubuo yung transparency portal.

segments.text: At ang layunin po ay talagang maging accessible at transparent sa public ang information.

segments.text: Alam naman ho natin kasi ang kainaman ng ganitong meron tayong transparency portal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Para sa ganon ay easy access kung meron ho tayong ninanais na malaman sa procurement man o etc. etc.

segments.text: Para sa ganun maiwasan po natin yung mga overlapping at alam natin specifically na dito ilalagay at hindi po saan napupunta.

segments.text: Babalikan ko rin po yung tanong na yan, Mr. Speaker.

segments.text: Ngayon po, noong nakaraang budget briefing, Mr. Speaker,

segments.text: Halimbawa, ilan yung irrigable lands, ilan yung mga non-irrigated, ilan yung annual targets,

segments.text: Tama po ba ito, Mr. Speaker?

segments.text: Yung 30% po ay base sa mga non-irrigable land pa.

segments.text: Titignan po natin yung pondong 3.2, ay yung land area na 3.2 million hectares.

segments.text: Ang 70% po nun ay na-develop na, although, andun po kasi yung sinabi natin kanina na nagkaroon po ng mga deductions

segments.text: dahil sa mga housing or non-agricultural development.

segments.text: Kaya yung 30% po na more or less 1 million hectares,

segments.text: ay yun po yung kasalukuyang pinupunuan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: At yun po yung kasalukuyang pinupunuan natin na maging eligible land.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Ang ka-akibat po kasing halaga na ito, pag kinuwento po natin,

segments.text: ay katulad ng sinasabi nga po natin kanina, more or less, mas 1 trillion pesos.

segments.text: Kaya kung titignan nga po natin, no,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: yung 400,000 biyan, 2030, another 400 plus billion pesos.

segments.text: Kung i-divide po natin sa sampuntaw nyo, more or less, mga,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: lumalabas po mga more or less 160 billion pesos per year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, malinaw po yung targeting, no, ng National Irrigation Administration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And in fact, binanggit din po sa briefing na annually, nasa 1.5% ang na-accomplish ng NIA.

segments.text: Yung hung yearly na nade-develop based doon sa graph na lumabas ho na in 10 years mula noong 2015.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Kung sa tignan ho natin, yun yung increase yung 1.5%.

segments.text: So, ito pong tinatanong ko, Mr. Speaker, at sa ating kaibigang sponsor,

segments.text: pagpapatunay lang po yan na ang NIA merong master plan na sinusundan,

segments.text: at malinaw sa ahensya kung saan ilalagay, ano yung ilalagay, ilan ang ilalagay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, doon sa sinusundang master plan, very specific, determined by the National Irrigation Administration,

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Colleague, tama po.

segments.text: Yung hung tinatawag natin, yung binigay sa atin, yung una, yung National Irrigation Master Plan na dinisekho ng NIA

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan

segments.text: Yung paggawa ng FS, pondohan natin, at para sa ganun, alam natin na yearly, doon ho, may pattern na tayo dapat sundan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Hindi na ho yung lipad-lipad pa.

segments.text: Yun ho yung sa malakihang usapin, lalo tigit sa CIS, saka NIS.

segments.text: So, maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, dahil pinagtibay uli ng NIA through the sponsor na very specific, determined yung mga areas.

segments.text: Ang ibig sabihin lang naman po nito, very specific, tama po ba?

segments.text: In-admit din po ng NIA, Mr. Speaker, na very specific yung mga proyekto at mga programang pang-irigasyon na ini-implement ng NIA.

segments.text: Ngayon, Mr. Speaker, ang tanong po ng kinatawang ito, sa page 844 ng General Appropriations Bill,

segments.text: Isan daang milyong piso ang inihinging budget ng NIA.

segments.text: Ang nakasulat lang po dito, Mr. Speaker, rehabilitation and protection of watershed management.

segments.text: sapagkat katulad ng HALAOR, kundi ako ba-ba-ba, ay mayroon 40, ilang tausan yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ganito kasi, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Nakita ko kasi sa record na may saraw tong programa na to na 14.3 billion, 20-25, pero ang obligated lang is 4.1 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, ano po yung nag-prevent sa agency?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: From utilizing yung pondo na nasa saraw, bakit po hindi nagamit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Actually, actually, kung Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, no, ang pondo, usually po ay, yun nga, sinasabi natin, pag dumating ang pondo, hindi ma-obligate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Dahil sa hindi pa na-procure, maaring ganun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: yung iba naman ho ay, kung sakali man na-procure na po siya, for awarding na siya, for notice to proceed na, makapag-umpisa na rin po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Kaya hindi, kasi ganun ho talaga minsan, katulad ho nung ibang pondo natin sa last year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: eh dumating na ho yung saraw, isa ho, malaking project din ho yun, pet project, big tickets,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: hindi rin ma-iaward agad, hindi ma-iobligate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Obligate ka agad, although dyan na saraw, kapagkat dahil ho yung laki nung project, kailangan ho nating may kapartner sa labas ng bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: So, series of bidding na kinandak, at nagkaroon ho rin ng problema, until now, meron pa rin mga, wala pa rin pumapas ang contractor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Kasi kung local contractor po kasi ang sasali, hindi ho sila makakwalified.

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: Kaya minsan, pag may pondo ho nandyan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Joseph S. Tan
segments.text: hindi ma-obligate, kaya nakikita ho natin na talagang, maski nandunay saraw, ay hindi pa ma-100% yung obligation, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yan po yung concern ko, Distinguished Sponsor, kasi naghahanap tayo ng pondo para sa pangangailangan ng erigasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tama naman po yung sponsorship speech mo, tama po lahat yun, I agree.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: With all of that, kaya lang, sayang po yung pondo na di nagamit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kagaya nung 2025, ang target po natin na service areas ay...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: 8,692 hektars. Pero yung actual lang po natin na na-accomplish, 3,162.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang nakita ko lang na problema, sa 2027, bumaba yung budget natin, yung sabi mo, mga 19%,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: pero nilakihan pa natin yung target area, ginawa natin from 8,620 to 11,153.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Huwag nyo na pong sagutin, Distinguished Sponsor, inano ko lang yung atensyon ni Admin Guillen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: na sana, I hope, and pray,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: na kahit man lang sa 11,000, maabot natin yung 10,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi sa experience natin, halos kalahati lang sa target ang na-accomplish.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Nakita ko naman yung sipag. I don't know with the other areas, pero yung nasayan ngayon sa Surigao,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: medyo masipag ho talaga sila ni Yamis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: pinapaabot ko lang, Distinguished Sponsor, Mr. Speaker, ay...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: dahil tinaasan pa natin lalo yung target,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: sana ho ay pagpalain tayo na makuha natin kahit man lang 10,000 doon sa 11,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, dahil ayaw na po natin may makarating na kasamahan ako at madagdagan yung mga katanungan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, there being no other members, as of now,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: With the indulgence po of the Honorable Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker and distinguished colleagues in this August Chamber,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I rise today and it is a distinct honor for me to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: of the Department of Agriculture, including its attached agencies and government corporations

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: as contained in the National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And the proposed budget of the Department stands at

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: billion, or 8% lower than the 215.69 billion appropriated last year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, we enter this budget year with encouraging evidence that our investments are beginning to bear fruit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: In 2025, the Philippine Statistics Authority reported that the agriculture, forestry, and fishing sector grew by 3.1%,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: In the second quarter alone, the value of agriculture and fisheries production increased by 2.9% year-on-year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Crops, livestock, poultry, and fisheries all reported increases in the value of production.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: We have also seen concrete progress on the ground.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Through programs such as Rice for All, 20 Pesos Rice, Kadiwa, enhanced buffer stocking and support provided under the Rice Tariffication Law, the government has continued to address the twin objectives of keeping food accessible to consumers while providing better support to our producers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: However, Mr. Speaker, these gains should not make us rest. This reminds us that growth in value does not automatically mean that physical production is secure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: This is a central challenge before us. How do we keep food affordable for Filipino families while making farming and fishing profitable enough for Filipino producers to remain in the sector?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The answer cannot be found in one commodity, one agency, or one program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And it requires a complete value chain approach.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And this is why the 2027 budget must continue to protect the gains that we have now reached and must focus on investments that raise productivity, reduce cost, improve farm and fishery infrastructure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: minimize our post-harvest losses, strengthen our cold chain and logistics systems, expand market access, improve irrigation, modernize our fisheries,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: reduce smuggling, and make climate change resilience and disaster management and preparation part of every agricultural investment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the proposed DA budget is smaller than last year's allocation, but the responsibilities before the department have not decreased.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The department itself has emphasized that the 2027 budget must prioritize productivity, infrastructure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: post-harvest systems, market access, technology, climate change, adaptation and mitigation, disaster preparedness, and stronger agricultural and fisheries value chains.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The challenge before us, therefore, is not simply how much we appropriate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: It is how much value we create from every peso that we appropriated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So every peso must translate into a hectare made more productive,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: a fisherfolk family made more resilient,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Farmers and fisher folks' children able to go to school, a road that actually connects a farm to a market,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: a crop saved from post-harvest loss, animals protected from disease, smugglers caught and prosecuted,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: a farmer protected from disaster, and a Filipino family able to buy safe and nutritious food at a reasonable price.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So let us not go backwards.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: From the gains of last year, instead, let us make the 2027 agricultural investment a forward-looking investment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: not merely in production, but in productivity, profitability, resilience, and food security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And again, let us make our 2027 agriculture budget one that truly addresses poverty in the agricultural sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And let us make our budget able to entice younger people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: We wish to build an agricultural sector where fisher folks and farmers are not simply benefiting from government programs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: but competitive participants and self-investors in a modern and growing economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And ultimately, let us ensure that the measures of this budget will not just be an amount today, but an investment into the future.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So that we may have better harvests, higher income, lower losses, stronger rural communities, and more profitable farmers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And may that we secure food supply that all Filipinos will be able to experience today and in the future.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And for these reasons, Mr. Speaker, I respectfully urge this honorable house to support the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Agriculture

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: and its attached agencies and corporations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, at mabuhay po ang mga magsasakang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Bondoc. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eduardo R. Rama Jr.

segments.text: ang mga formal na dokumento at ulat na ipinangakong maibibigay po sa kinatawa na ito.

Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I'd like to correct myself po, dumating na po yung report tungkol sa anti-rabies program

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: from the Bureau of Animal Industry. So yung research and investigation report na lang

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: po on Pax Silica's impact on farmers na nirequest din po ng kinatawan ng Gabriela Women's

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Party at nagre-request din po ng kopya itong representasyon nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Speaker, Madam, for this question, which I'm sure concerns every

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: single Filipino, mas lalo na po kami who live in Central Luzon where the Pax Silica is

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: supposed to be located. Unfortunately, I myself wrote the Department of National Defense

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: not only asking about why did I write the DND, because it's not only the DA, but it's

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: National Defense, which includes food security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So basically, hindi rin ho sila nakasagot. And their answer to me was, it's the problem

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: daw of the BCDA, Mr. Speaker. But I think this is not only the problem of a single agency,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: but a problem of multiple agencies working together. So I have conferred with my colleagues

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: and most especially, Honorable Secretary Tiu Laurel. And what I was informed is, this

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: is an all-encompassing report, so they need time. And end of September is the deadline

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, Mr. Speaker, inaasahan po na ang agricultural aspect ng Pax Silica, na bahagi po nito ay

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ano yung mangyayari sa mga magsasakang na roon po ngayon sa site, yung claims nila sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: lands. Ito po ay maisasaklaw ng BCDA report. Ito po ba ay gagawin in collaboration with

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: DA? So may bahagi rin po yung DA sa paggawa at pagsumite?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: This question again, ano, Mr. Speaker? And this question doesn't only merely include

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: the farmers who are located in the land of the Pax Silica itself, but this includes also

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: we will be discussing power supply and water supply. Because as we know po, malaki na po

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: ang pag-aagawan po ng mga magsasaka and Metro Manila regarding the water supply. So

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: if we put the water supply needs of Pax Silica, then this becomes an even greater issue. So

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: we will not only study those farmers in that area of the Pax Silica, but all farmers within

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: a wide radius because of the various resources that are Pax Silica is going to need. So rest

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: assured that the Department of Agriculture will be one of the lead agencies in formulating

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: this position paper and impact assessment. So siguro I am envisioning DNR, DA, DND, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: That would come up with a comprehensive report. And as our good secretary has said, the DA

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: will comply with their portion by the end of September.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker. Magre-request po ang kinatawa na ito ng kopya ng report

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: once available pag ito po ay naitapos na by end of September. Mr. Speaker, good sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ang sunod na lang po nating tanong ay tungkol po sa mga datos na binahagi ng DA nung nakaraang

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Workers at ng RA 8435, obligado rin ang gobyerno na protektahan ng prime agricultural lands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa pagtukoy kung paano nakakatuwang ang DA sa usaping land reform,

segments.text: Ito po ay pagkatapos ibahagi yung data point last budget briefing na ang average farm size in the Philippines is only around 3.59 to 2.03 hectares.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, given na nga na kakaunti sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At syempre kakaunti pa yung may ganitong democratic na paghatian ng mga agricultural lands,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: paano po natin may ensure na hindi mailalabas sa agricultural classification ang mga natitirang sakahan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And that is really a major concern of the Department of Agriculture, is how to preserve the remaining agricultural lands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And as we know, there are a lot of areas that are rapidly industrializing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: One of the things that we need to do is, there are actually a two-pronged approach.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: One is to provide value to agricultural lands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And the way to do this is to make them more productive, and not only to increase production, but to increase profitability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Because if all farmers are making a profit from their land, then they would not be so quick to sell them to other persons.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So number one is production and profitability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So the DA is trying to increase its production, and hopefully also through reduction of post-harvest losses,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: proper irrigation, support for fertilizers and pesticides, and the proper prices, farm gate prices,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: then farmers will be able to make a living, and will not be tempted to sell their lots to speculators and developers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Secondly, that's the approach towards the farmer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: There also needs to be an approach towards developers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And one of the ways that the DA can do this is to work with the LGUs to discuss conversion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: There should be strict rules and guidelines, and if necessary, to even put conversion moratoriums,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: so that developers will not be able to just...

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And destroy, unfortunately, irrigated land, which has happened very frequently.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So I would say, there would be a two-pronged approach.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: To raise value for the farmers, so that they won't sell their land, and number two, is to put a stop to conversion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: There's nothing wrong with taking on a loan, especially if you know that your cooperative or that your irrigators association will be able to project a good income for the next 5, 3, 5, 8, 10 years and be able to support the loan that you have taken.

segments.text: The DA has sent inspection teams to the ports of Manila, Manila International Container Port,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Sambuanga, and Cagayan de Oro to monitor and support border inspections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So despite the limited budget, ginagawa po nila yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Meron din po silang DAIE teams to monitor and witness the conduct of the second border inspection and condemnation activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Meron din po silang Special Operations Group to serve as the official representative of the office

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And they have an investigation branch to monitor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: To monitor the implementation of banner programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And to monitor also illegal smuggling and economic sabotage activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So despite their limited budget due to limited fiscal space,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: they are doing a variety of activities to be able to support our anti-smuggling and anti-economic sabotage policies.

segments.text: What I'm trying to say is...

Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.

Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.

segments.text: My question is, ito ba 750,000 because of El Nino effect?

segments.text: Ito ba ay tatamaan tayo around 750,000 metric tons?

segments.text: Tama po yan, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, I guess the next question, because of how to mitigate and plano nang nyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: sinagot mo na because of the cloud seeding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ano yung cloud seeding to prevent...

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Our plans for El Nino include cloud seeding,

Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.

segments.text: And also, finding proper climate change resilient varieties that they could plant,

segments.text: which could survive with less water.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And as a sponsor of this representation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: thanks to the distinguished sponsor for the responses and clarification.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: With that, I have no more further questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I support the budget of Department of Agriculture

segments.text: kasi napaka-importante po sa ating mga mamayang Pilipino.

segments.text: Maraming salamat din po, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung ano-ano na yung mga programa

segments.text: na ipatupad ng Department of Agriculture

segments.text: kaugnay ng mandato nito sa Uplift?

segments.text: At magkano na ang nagastos natin ngayong 2026?

segments.text: At meron ho ba tayong plano para sa 2027

segments.text: na mapagpatuloy yung iba't-ibang assistance program

segments.text: na may kinalaman sa pagtugon sa impact ng pagtaas

segments.text: ng presyo ng langis sa mga magsasaka at manginisda?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Nagbigay, thank you so much for this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: This is a very, very urgent concern, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Nagbigay po ang Department of Agriculture ng Fuel Assistance

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: to farmers and fisher folks and fertilizer assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, saan po nang galing na particular line item

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang pinagkunan ng Department of Agriculture

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa fuel subsidies na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nang galing po ba sa Presidential Assistance

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron pa ba tayong ibang mga line item

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na pinagkunan ng napakahalaga na fuel subsidies na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The assistance po to our farmers

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: was taken from the savings of the DBM,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yun po ang pinagkakunan po

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ang isa po sa mabigat na balita sa ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ngayong linggo ay muli na namang tumaas

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ang kapulungan na ito sa 20th Congress

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na nagbibigay ng emergency powers sa presidente

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: o mabawasan ang excise taxes sa petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahil alam po natin kung gaano ginagamit

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa kanilang mga makinarya, traktora, ang langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ganon din po sa mga manging isda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung krudo na ginagamit nila sa pamamalakaya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ay nakakaapekto po ang mataas na presyo ng langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa katunayan, yung isa nga pong mahalagang concern na napaabot din natin sa ating lead council dito sa House of Representatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: hindi po talaga sapat yung mga fuel subsidy dahil nasa 2,000 plus pesos lang po ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at malayo doon sa kinakailangan na nasa 15,000 to 30,000 na kailangan ng isang bangka

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para matiyak na siya ay makapamalaot at magaroon ng huli.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya ang nangyayari, yung dapat sana na fuel subsidy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: imbes na gamitin nila pambili ng langis, ay ginagamit na lang pong pambili ng pagkain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang nangyayari po dyan, natatalo po yung ating layunin na matulak ang mga magsasaka at mangingisda. Sa magsasaka, magpatuloy sa pagtatanim at sa mga mangingisda naman, makapagpatuloy po sa paglaot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, dahil po naglabas na ng certification ang Department of Energy at tungkol po dun sa pag-abot natin dun sa trigger na nasa 80 US dollars per barrel na presyo po ng Dubai crude oil,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: meron na po ba tayong maaasahang aksyon mula dito sa uplift at meron po bang rekomendasyon ang Department of Agriculture tungkol sa pagsususpindi at pagbabawasan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Speaker. Ito po, I would like to share the position of the Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The DA supports in principle the temporary de-implementation or suspension of VAT and excise tax on fuel during periods of exceptionally high fuel prices as a measure to reduce cost pressures across the agricultural and fisheries value chain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Moreover po, ano pa po ang ginagawa natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: We are including the fuel assistance po sa ating QRF and we are seeking po more funds for fuel assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Ginong Speaker. Nagagalak po tayong marinig ng posisyon ng Department of Agriculture,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: hindi lang bawasan o hindi lang temporarily suspindihin ang excise taxes sa petroleum products, kundi pati na rin ang value-added tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napakabigat po ng 12% na VAT sa petroleum products na lalong nagpapasirit ng presyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nang langis, maaari po ba nating malaman kung ano pa ang hinihintay na desisyon pagdating sa pagsususpindi o pagbabawas o pagsama ng VAT?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil ang posisyon ng DA malinaw, pero sino pa po ba ang ating hinihintay sa ngayon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil ang DOE may certification na yung uplift ba, nakapagpulong na po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kailan po natin maaasahan na magkaroon ng anunsyo tungkol sa paggamit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nang emergency powers na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, last week po, there was a high-level cabinet meeting regarding increasing fuel prices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, rest assured na pinagplaplanuhan na po ang pagtaas, sadly, ang pagtaas ng fuel prices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ang panawagan po ng representasyon na ito dapat sa lalong madaling panahon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil yan naman po ang layunin ng pag-grant ng emergency powers na mabilis na magagawa ng aksyon yung dapat pong matugunan na issue ng ating mga kababayan sa pagsirit ng presyo ng lanis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Malinaw po na meron ng trigger, naabot na yan, may certification na rin mula sa DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang kinakailangan po natin, mabilis na aksyon ng pamahalaan tungkol dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil sa bawat araw na hindi tayo...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kumikilos sa bawat araw na naghihintay po tayo ng pag-anunsyo, ay isang araw din na lalong pinapasa ng mga kababayan natin yung mas mataas na presyo ng lanis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang po yan nakaka-apekto sa agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Alam po natin kung gano'n rin katindi ang impact sa transport sector, sa logistics, na lubos din po ang effect sa agriculture sector, sa delivery, sa transport ng kanilang mga local produce.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung pwede nga, pag-aralan na rin po ng kapulungan na ito na ibasura yung excise taxes sa petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Gayun din, panahon na na ma-review, hindi lang po yung pag-suspindi, pagbabawas, kundi yung pagtatanggal ng 12% na value-added tax sa mga mahalaga lang naman po na pangangailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kumbaga yung mga basic needs ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagkain, kuryente, iba pang utilities at langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sunod naman po, anais ko pong magtanong tungkol sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: 2024 Commission on Audit, Annual Audit Report Observation tungkol po sa pagpapatupad ng RSF at ng Rice Farmers Financial Assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sinabi po sa kanilang 2024 AAR na nakapagtala ng total na 58,784 farmer beneficiaries mula po sa mga piling rehyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sinabi po dito na hindi po lahat ng nakatanggap ay eligible.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari po ba tayong bigyan ng update ng Department of Agriculture tungkol dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano po ba natin natitiyak na lahat ng ating mga financial assistance na binibigay sa Rice Farmers ay napupunta dun sa mga nararapat, nangangailangan at tunay na qualified, batay po sa ating mga pamantayan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The DA goes through each and every complaint po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And we have a list po of resolved cases by the DA which we are happy to share po with our distinguished colleagues, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, Mr. Speaker, nandito po yung mga na-resolved issues po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And we are happy to share them with our colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And again, ano po, I personally witnessed the DA distribution of assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Napaka-thorough po po nila, including pictures of every single farmer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And when they give assistance, malakihan po yan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And we actually say on the mic, and I have to credit the DA po, sinasabi po nila, kung meron pong may reklamo, magreklamo na po on the spot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: If they do feel that an unqualified person.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Actually, tying it to our previous distinguished colleagues, Mr. Speaker, question about the RSBSA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Actually, I would be more concerned about persons not, qualified persons not receiving assistance versus like a syndicate of unqualified persons rushing to receive assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: As we have discussed earlier, there is actually an undercount of the RSBSA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, ang dami pong, mas marami pong nagre-reklamo po sa amin na hindi po sila nasama doon sa tulong ng DA kesa sa doon sa nagre-reklamo na hindi po qualified yung katabi po nilang kasama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, again, we can only correct all of these and resolve all of these and rest assured that the DA is very open to complaints right there and then on the spot po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Pwede pong magreklamo at tatanggapin po namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Aside from that po, we also need to work po with the LGUs kasi sila po talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: We don't have extension workers and the mouse to make sure po na yung talagang tama ho yung kuhanan po, nabigyan po ng assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And rest assured po, if we find anybody or any group that is organizing themselves and falsely misrepresenting themselves to receive assistance from the government, e kakasuhan po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dalawang bagay na napakahalaga mula po sa sagot ng ating Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung una, dapat naman talaga matiyak natin na kung ano yung observation ng COA magagawa natin ng paraan para mahigpit at kung ano yung dapat na financial assistance sa mga rice farmers na sobrang sobra na apektado ng rice importation ay ating matutulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa pangalawang mahalagang bagay na nabanggitin nyo, yung kahirapan din ng ating mga farmers sa pagpaparegister.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa totoo lang po, hindi po yan ang unang pagkakataon na narinig ng representasyon na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang po sa mga magsasaka, pero sa bahagi din po ng ating mga banging isda na hindi po lahat, lalong-lalo na yung ating mga maliliit na mga fisher folk ay nakakapagparegister at napapaabutan po ng kinakailangan na tulong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Abagamat, naiintindihan ko po, kasi nakita rin natin dito, Mr. Speaker, na bagamat gusto pong matulungan lahat ng mga nakaregister, napakaliit na prosyento lang po yung natutulungan kasi napakalimitado lang po ng pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para sa ganitong tipo ng mga subsidies at mga financial assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya nga po, at nakita ko rin po ang puno ng ating committed agriculture na tayo po ay hindi lang umaasa, pero excited po tayo na dapat naman,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung paano ko na napag-usapan yung pinapanawagan na production subsidy ng mga farmers and fisher folk dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil, Mr. Speaker, sa kanila din po nagmumula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nagmumula yung mga pinakamahihirap nating mga kababayan na nanatiling nasa 25 to 36 percent pa rin po ang poverty incidence sa sektor ng agriculture,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lalong-lalo na po farmer, fisher folk at workers in the agricultural sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon po, meron ba kayong proposal dun po sa inyong original na naisumite sa DBM na may kinalaman sa fuel subsidies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: and production subsidies na hindi naisama sa General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung mga priority natin na sa tingin po natin dapat pondohan, pero sa ngayon ay hindi nalaana ng pondo sa General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, tinatanong ko ito dahil ang mga magsasaka at may ngisda talaga pong gustong banguna rin na itulak

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na ito na dapat huwag tayong pumayag na hindi malalagyan ng production subsidies sa ngayon ang ating farmers and fisher folk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Tama po yun. Sadly, I have to agree po with our distinguished colleagues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The DA budget has been reduced by 8 percent and we are requesting, number one po, meron po silang 11-point strategic plan para po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: po, ma-maintain po ang ating gains in production, which we are afraid po dahil tama po yung sinabi ng ating distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Sadly, I have to agree na marami pong nagkulang. So, we are requesting po more assistance for the expanded fertilizer assistance, almost 9B.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Yung ating farm-to-market bridges development program. Ito po para gumanda po yung logistics.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Our hybrid solar power ice plants at marami pa pong iba, which I would be happy to share with our distinguished colleagues dito, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, mahingi din na lang po tayo ng detalyadong report tungkol naman sa access sa fertilizer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil po bukod sa langis, yan din po ang isa sa pinakasumirit ang presyo dahil muli nakaasa na naman po tayo sa importation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Samantalang, marami din pong lumapit sa representasyon na ito na marami pong mga locally developed fertilizer na kulang-nakulang po ang suporta pagdating sa pagsiscale ng production para makatulong sa ating local agriculture.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
