segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: At kung may report po sa inyo

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: ako po mismo, sasamahan ko sila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That's why I like this guy, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I support the budget of DILG

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: to the entire family of DILG.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable De Jesus. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Robert Nazal

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I'd like to go to my first question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: may I ask our distinguished colleague

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: how seriously are we monitoring LGU compliance

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: with the expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We continue to receive many complaints

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: that the benefits are provided by law,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and the implementation of the solo parent booklet.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: how many LGUs are actually providing

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And how many qualified solo parents

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Thank you for that, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: hindi lang po trabaho ng DILG yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: There's a joint circular na kasama po dyan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, can I be clarified with the question again?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ilan pong LGUs ang actual na nag-proprovide

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: hindi rin po obligasyon ito ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Siyempre, the LGUs are under the DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, ang tanong ko po is,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ilan po ang LGUs that are providing

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and how many qualified solo parents

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, that is a very good question,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: but as of now, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I would like to apologize, indulgence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Napakalawak po, but I totally agree with you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And galing rin po ako sa LGU,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: although may autonomy po ang LGU,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: but nasa mandato rin po yan

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: lalo na sa mga single parents.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yes, and this is a national law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: we asked the DILG to study

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: with the Solo Parents' Welfare Act

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: can be incorporated into the seal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: of good local governance and DILG promised that they would study it, ano po ang naging resulta nito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And can DILG commit today to actual implementation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: At pwede na po bang isama sa seal of good governance ang compliance nito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, actually yan na po yung ginagawa po ng DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Hindi lang po ang pag-aral nito, hindi kung paano na po isagawa po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, duly noted ang magandang suggestion ng ating butihin na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, is there, can DILG commit to a date or kung kailan po natin pwedeng i-implement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kahit yung isama lang po sa seal of good governance itong implementation ng Solo Parents Welfare Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Nasa TWG na po ito. So, hopefully within siguro, I think a month, ano po, I think in one month,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, mayroon po sila ng bagong regulasyon tungkol po dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Okay. Thank you for that, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, we have a commitment from DILG na lalabas na po ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, but Mr. Speaker, kahit ilabas po ito, ang timeline po natin is for next year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Do we have a date kung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And may we request the DILG to regularly furnish the office of this representation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We have a status of LGU compliant, so we can follow up on non-compliant LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Para matulungan din po namin kayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, duly noted, and thank you for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: My next question, Distinguished Colleague, Mr. Speaker, is on the Unified 9-1-1.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, through you, COA found that the 9-1-1 Emergency Services Program had an obligation rate of only 2.45% in 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I ask, bakit po 2.45% lang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And what has changed since then?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Can you repeat the question again? I'm sorry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yung ano po, COA found that the 9-1-1 Emergency Services Program had an obligation rate of only 2.45% in 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, the question is, bakit po 2.45% na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And what has changed since then?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I think the problem was the vehicles, Mr. Speaker, but we have updated it already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, sigurado po, mas matasa po yan ngayon, based on the data sa 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, for 2025 po and 2026, magkano po ang na-appropriate?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Na-obligate and was actually disbursed for Unified 9-1-1?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Appropriated, released, obligated, and actually disbursed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: That was allocated, but the disbursement is around 1.4 billion for 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can our Distinguished Colleague break down the spending, how much went to the technology platform,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and private service providers, command centers, and telecommunications, ambulances, and other vehicles, personnel, and training?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, can we submit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Since marami po ito, if you can give us time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Isasubmit po natin sa ating pong colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can our Distinguished Colleague also confirm that 9-11 is completely free to the public?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And on the government side, what are we paying annually?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Including recurring service, technology, telecommunications, or other fees to operate Unified 9-1-1?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Free po yung call ng public.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But to call for the public, it's free.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can I also get a report on papano po ito nadi-disperse?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, we will submit by today, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Distinguished Colleague, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I ask, how many genuine emergencies resulted in an actual dispatch?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And what is the average response?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: From receipt of a 9-1-1 call, not merely until somebody answers this phone, the telephone,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: but until the appropriate responder physically arrives at the scene?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The average response time is 5 to 7 minutes, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Do we measure how many patients were successfully assisted or stabilized?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: How many emergencies were resolved through timely intervention?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Measurable how many lives were saved because of a timely 9-1-1 response?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We just have to pull up the data and submit to our colleague, Congressman Robert Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But definitely, alam po yan ng ating pong 9-1-1 responders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, just for example, ito po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, from September 11, 2025 to July 31, 2026, the National Call Center recorded 14,461,871 incoming calls.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The volume is approximately 53,000 incoming calls per day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ilan po yung actual na-save natin dun sa mga totoong may emergency?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can a measurable emergency outcome become an actual performance indicator tied to 9-1-1?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kung pwede po na maging KPI,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: yung Unified 9-1-1, yung measurable emergency outcome?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And maganda po yung suggestion yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And can the DILG agree to that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Na isama po natin yun, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I'll go to my next question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: if the real measure of 9-1-1 is timely response and life-saving,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: then hindi po sapat na mabilis dumating ang ambulansya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Pagdating ng ambulance, may trained person ba na kayang magsimulang magligtas ng buhay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: TESDA po already has a specific paramedic training program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, my question is, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: can the Unified 9-1-1 budget be used to train LGU personnel as paramedics using these existing TESDA programs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We have 5,000 nurses nakasama po dyan under sa BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, wala pong aandar na ambulansya, wala pong trained nurses na sumagip ng buhay ng ating mga mamayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Meron pong nurse, I agree to that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang tanong is, is that nurse qualified also as a paramedic?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, pwede po ba natin, kasi kaya ako sinasabi, meron nang existing TESDA programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The DILG is doing that already, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, more importantly, can the DILG establish a national policy or standard that every ambulance operating as part of an LGU emergency response

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: or Unified 9-1-1 system should eventually have at least one properly trained and certified paramedic on board?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Actually, Mr. Speaker, I think that's a very good question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Pero lumalabas na po yan sa saklaw ng...

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But if we make a law regarding this, mas lalo po natin mabibigyan ngipin ang DILG and even po na sumunod, lalo na ang ating mga local government units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kaya ako lang po binabanggit kasi, siyempre, under po kasi yung LGU emergency response dun sa mga LGU nga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And in an emergency, siyempre, every minute counts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kung may trained paramedic sa ambulance, hindi kailangang hintayin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Makarating sa ER bago magsimula ang proper intervention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Habang nasa ambulance pa lang, pwede nang ma-assess, ma-stabilize, at mabigyan ng appropriate pre-hospital care ang pasyente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi those minutes can save a life.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, ang BFP natin are personally trained.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And actually, hindi lang po sila sila yung trained, but they're also extending training.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Lalo na po sa ating mga local.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, ang problema nito, hindi lang po ito problema ng DILG o ng BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Problema po ito ng local government units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kaya nga po, kinukompleto natin mga fire trucks, kinukompleto natin ang fire station.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Sana makompleto pa natin yung ambulances.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Lalo na pag na-release lang, 80% lang po ang inihingi na naka-earmark po para sa BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Para po, mahintunin yung kaka-hingi po natin na parang nagmamakaawat tayo ng mga ambulanses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Totoo yun. And I agree to that. And I fully support yung sinasabi mo, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: What I'm asking is tulong naman po ito para sa unified 911 program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And tinatanong ko, can DILG commit to work with DESDA and DOH on a national standard?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: With a reasonable transition period that every LGU 911 ambulance should have a trained paramedic on board?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And DILG is working on it, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And can the 2027 911 budget be used to begin training these paramedics?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If not, what specific authority or budget provision does DILG need from Congress para po magawa po natin ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, actually po ang mga BFP kasi natin po is NC2 trained po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And well, we really need them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kung hindi lang po yung 911 even sa training.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But we make do of what we have.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: There are no reasons dahil kulang sa pondo, ihinto tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Hindi po yan ang patakaran ng ating Secretary Jalvik Rimulya under his leadership.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So nakita naman po natin ang response time ng police.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Nakita naman po natin ang galaw ng BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So I'm very proud and privileged to defend the DILG family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Because they are really performing well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Lalo na po sa mga nangyari sa ating pong bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Pero kung kulang man ang pondo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: dyan po may sinubmit na po ang DILG family na dapat pag-usapan po dito sa plenaryo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kung performing, I believe in meritocracy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kung performing ang agency, dapat natin pong dagdagan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Dahil safety po ng tao ang pinag-usapan po natin dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yes, and I agree to that 101% distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So ang akin lang naman po ay tulong and suggestions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Because yung current 911 program po sa Amerika,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: kahit daw yung mga driver ng ambulansya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ay may special training sa paramedic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Ah yeah, sana po umabot tayo sa ganong level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Okay, let me proceed to my next question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, just one constructive question for the BJMP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Are all eligible PDLs or persons deprived of liberty registered with PhilHealth?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And are the BJMP facilities actively linking them to YACAP accredited facilities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: yung YACAP program po ng PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: so that they can access covered medicines through YACAP gamot?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If not, what is preventing this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Not all facilities, but nagsisimula na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But I will be able to give you the specific number at the proper time,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, thank you for that, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can the BJMP coordinate with PhilHealth?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang akin lang naman po ay para makabawas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yung BJMP na kung meron silang binibili ng gamot,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: yung mga kasama na dun sa YACAP gamot at sa YACAP clinics,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ay hindi na po nila kailangan i-purchase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Pwede na lang bilhin dun sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yung mga pera nila, yung mga gamot na lang na kailangan na wala dun sa YACAP gamot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes. Actually, BJMP is doing that already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Pero dapat po sigurong pa-ingtingin pa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: lalo na ang coordination sa ating mga LGUs na may YACAP and gamot program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, sana po ma-improve lang natin yung registration at ma-qualify natin itong mga PPS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes. It's still ongoing and gagawin po yan ng BJMP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And going to the BFP, Mr. Speaker...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We already discussed BFP extensively during the committee hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So hindi ko na puulitin yung aking detailed questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But the CPBRD's review of COA findings shows that as of the end of 2025,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: 100 municipalities still had no activated fire stations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: 64 had neither a fire station or a fire truck.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And BFP had shortages of 20,854 fire coats,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Considering that the BFP has its regular appropriations plus fire code earmarked revenues,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: may we request the BFP to submit to this representation

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: a national master plan for completely closing these gaps.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: For every LGU still lacking a fire station,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and for every identified equipment shortage,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: what is needed, how much will it cost,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: including yung earmarked revenues po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and by what year will the deficiency be eliminated?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Isa pa pong tanong ko is,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: meron po ba tayong guideline or a scientific basis

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: on how many fire stations and fire trucks

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: pagka may one municipality na halimbawa 30 baranggays.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Tapos if the units are old na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: let's say mga 3 or 4 years old,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: kailan po ba siya dapat i-replace?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kailan po ba siya nagiging obsolete?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: talaga pong maraming challenges ang BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And I totally agree with my idol, Congressman Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
